source_evidence.finding: Capacity creates the disposable database, configures the native database, then loads and configures the runtime.
ConfigureNativeDatabase assigns FMDB.ConnectionString and provider to the owned connection.
ImprovingSkill spans both TraitUsed and the following Flush; the recorded stage cannot distinguish them.
Native skill use calls RawSkillImprovementCap and evaluates branching at the cap.
Skill cap uses cap history, enrolment, acquisition and support grants.
Progression persistence reads use new FMDB; cap history can be cached, while enrolment and acquisition still read persistence.

FMDB reuses CurrentSession or creates it; creation uses FMDB.ConnectionString for ServerVersion.AutoDetect, configured EF options and explicit MySqlConnector.Open. CurrentSession prefers an ambient session, otherwise the default session.
The context fallback only applies when options are not configured. FMDB supplies configured UseMySql options and uses the options constructor at line 227, bypassing the fallback on this path.
FlushCasting flushes SaveManager then saves actor, body and traits within new FMDB.
Save-manager initialization and save batches use FMDB.

qualifications: ConfigureNativeDatabase changes globals without resetting an existing session. An existing ambient/default session would retain its earlier connection. Source inspection alone cannot establish whether such a session existed at the failure instant.

The failed log contains a reconciliation message and harness assertion stack but no inner skill/database stack, so it cannot distinguish AutoDetect, explicit Open, EF query or subsequent flush failure.
No source path was found that constructs an unconfigured or parameterless context during the capacity cap, branch or flush route. No root cause inferred.
The later TIME_WAIT diagnostic is not a failure-instant measurement and establishes no cause.
